network.description: Networks with Intel coverage. Anything else is reported as unknown (partial), never as no_signals.

signalLevel.description: Public signal names. Internal levels (benign/unknown/suspicious/malicious) never appear in any schema.

stroops.description: Signed integer amount in stroops (7-decimal fixed point), as a decimal string so 64-bit values survive JavaScript.

facts.description: Structured, verifiable slot values. Values are plain strings; consumers must not linkify them.
